property_summary: C.createGameItem reverts exactly when the caller is not an admin, so the revert flag must equal !isAdmin(msg.sender).
compiler_error: exactly ONE assert(...) statement is required (found 2)

property_summary: For any tokenId without an admin-set custom URI, c.uri(tokenId) falls back to the base URI 'https://ipfs.io/ipfs/'.
For a freshly deployed C, any address holds zero balance of any game item id, even after admin-independent reads.
Setting approval for any operator other than the caller succeeds and makes isApprovedForAll true, while attempting to approve oneself always reverts and leaves approval false.
After an admin creates a game item with a non-empty tokenURI, the item count increases by one and uri() for the new id returns the custom URI instead of the base URI.
An address without burner authorization can never burn tokens: c.burn always reverts and leaves balances unchanged.
Creating a game item adds exactly one token: uniqueTokensOutstanding increases by one, remainingSupply(newId) equals the given itemsRemaining, and uri(newId) returns the custom URI when non-empty.
After an admin creates a game item with a positive daily allowance, the daily allowance remaining for any address on that item initially equals the item's dailyAllowance (when not yet replenished).
